theme.prompt_used: Design a UI screen for: Simple Notes App (Model Test). Objective: Build a minimal Next.js notes application to validate the Qwen3.5-27B-Claude-4.6-Opus-Reasoning-Distilled model. The app should have: (1) Create/edit/delete notes with title and body, (2) Local storage persistence, (3) Search/filter notes by text, (4) Responsive Tailwind CSS design, (5) TypeScript throughout. Keep it simple — single-page SPA with no backend.. Design brief summary: Simple notes app - clean minimalist UI with Tailwind CSS. Single-page layout with note list sidebar and editor panel. Mobile-responsive. Style guidance: Components: NoteCard, NoteList, NoteEditor, SearchBar. Colors: neutral grays with blue accent. Layout: responsive 2-column on desktop, stacked on mobile.
